title: 商務進階必備字彙 (TOEIC 600-780) - 第 2 單元 (401~800 字)
description: 中階多益綠色至藍色證書核心單字，包含採購、會議、財務與差旅實戰。（分單元 2/9）

words.definitionZh: 承包商；簽約人員（通常指為公司或組織提供服務或完成專案的獨立人士或公司）

visualAnchor.imagePrompt: Modern smart logistics distribution fulfillment center, inventory logistics manager inspecting automated supply chain manifests on tablet, high-tech warehouse racks, photorealistic, cinematic lighting, ultra-detailed
visualAnchor.scene: 現代化智慧物流轉運中心主管審核出貨清單之作業場景

examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: During the annual shareholders meeting, executive directors highlighted the fundamental importance of contractors.
examples.zh: 在年度股東大會上，執行董事們強調了【承包商】的根本重要性。

examples.en: The plant supervisor implemented strict operational guidelines to ensure consistent quality in contractors.
examples.zh: 廠房主管實施了嚴格的營運準則，以確保在【承包商】方面保持一致的高品質。

examples.en: Strategic investment in contractors has positioned our enterprise as a frontrunner in global market competition.
examples.zh: 在【承包商】上的策略性投資，使我司在全球市場競爭中躍居領先地位。

quizzes.stem: The regional director emphasized that corporate _____ remains our highest priority for the upcoming fiscal year.
quizzes.stemTranslation: 區域總監強調，企業【承包商】依然是我們下一會計年度的首要重點。
quizzes.strategy: 空格位於 corporate 之後作為名詞主詞/受詞，選入名詞 contractors 最切合商務方針。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 注意名詞單複數與可數/不可數之文法特徵。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】詞義「承包商」與文法形態完全切合題幹之商務語境。
【干擾】此選項與題幹前後文意及商務搭配不符，予以排除。

quizzes.stem: Strict compliance with established _____ is mandatory for all personnel operating heavy machinery.
quizzes.stemTranslation: 切實遵守既定的【承包商】，對於所有操作重型機具之人員皆屬強制規定。
quizzes.strategy: established 為形容詞，介系詞 with 之後需填入受詞名詞 contractors。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】文法詞性完全符合空格之結構要求。

quizzes.stem: In the business memorandum, the word 'contractors' is closest in meaning to which of the following?
quizzes.stemTranslation: 在該商務備忘錄中，單字「contractors」（【承包商】）的意思與下列何者最接近？
quizzes.strategy: 在商務語境中，contractors（承包商）之核心涵義與 contractors 最相近。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 多益同義字測驗考查商務上下文語境，需選擇最具替換性之選項。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】在商務語境中為最精確之同義詞替換。

quizzes.stem:
📧 [INTERNAL MEMORANDUM]
To: All Department Staff
Subject: Important Operational Update

Please ensure that our division takes all necessary measures to _____ established corporate benchmarks across daily operations.
quizzes.stemTranslation:
📧【內部備忘錄】
收件人：全體部門同仁
主旨：重要營運更新

請確保我們部門採取一切必要措施，在日常營運中【承包商】既定的企業基準。
quizzes.strategy: 內部備忘錄公告提及 takes measures to _____（採取措施以...），填入 contractors 最切合商務政策語境。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 內部行政備忘錄常使用正式書面語體與政策規章搭配。

📩 [CLIENT CORRESPONDENCE]
To: Global Procurement Partners
Subject: Partnership and Service Confirmation

We are delighted to confirm that our organization can _____ your upcoming business requirements on schedule.
quizzes.stemTranslation:
📩【客戶商務信函】
收件人：全球採購合作夥伴
主旨：合作關係與服務確認

我們很高興地向您確認，我司能夠按既定時程【承包商】貴方未來的商務需求。

📢 [EXECUTIVE POLICY ANNOUNCEMENT]
To: All Branch Directors
Subject: Long-term Development Framework

The executive board has approved comprehensive guidelines to _____ sustainable performance across all regional subsidiaries.
quizzes.stemTranslation:
📢【高層政策公告】
收件人：各分行總監
主旨：長期發展架構藍圖

examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: The facility management team worked diligently to contrast the urgent requirements of visiting international delegates.
examples.zh: 廠區管理團隊辛勤作業，以【對比】來訪國際代表的緊急需求。

quizzes.stem: The executive management committee agreed to _____ the client's urgent proposal after a detailed evaluation.
